source: local file: Screen Recording 2026-10-14 091701.mp4 (website design presentation; no URL; analysed from frames, no DOM)

taste.name: Show the Machine
taste.trigger: When illustrating what a banking API does
taste.decision: Chose real product fragments (JSON response, transfer card, dashboard) over abstract illustration or photography
taste.reason: The reader is a developer; seeing the payload persuades more than a metaphor

taste.name: Neon on the Rim
taste.decision: Kept it to the outer frame, primary buttons, eyebrow bars and active tab over section backgrounds
taste.reason: The page stays dark enough for long technical text while the brand still glows

taste.name: One Green Material
taste.trigger: When choosing neutrals for ground, cards and secondary controls
taste.decision: Tinted every dark toward green-teal over neutral charcoal
taste.reason: Tinted darks keep the brand present where no accent appears

taste.name: Signposted Sections
taste.trigger: When starting each topic on a long page
taste.decision: Chose an identical eyebrow pill before every headline over plain or numbered headings
taste.reason: A repeated mark signals a new topic before a word is read
evidence: always followed by a Title Case headline
